overall.flag: Good 73.7%, Mixed 18.3%, Bad 5.7%, Not verified 2.3%. Strong AI demand almost everywhere; the weak spots were Intel and Kioxia guidance and Broadcom and Qualcomm outlooks.

watch: Results are good, but share prices are already pricing in a lot. Lam, Tokyo Electron and Teradyne beat expectations and their shares still fell. Seven holdings, about 30% of the fund, report again in November: AMD, Astera (3 Nov), Qualcomm, Coherent (4 Nov), Infineon (10 Nov), Applied Materials (12 Nov) and NVIDIA (18 Nov, Melbourne time).
